title: Buddhist Temporalities (Amendment)
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE BUDDHIST TEMPORALITIES ORDINANCE.

edition.caveat: private republisher, not the Government Printer

body.heading: Short title and date of operation.
body.raw_text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Buddhist Temporalities (Amendment) Act, No. 18 of 1981, and shall come into operation on such date (hereinafter referred to as the " appointed date ") as the Minister by Order published in the Gazette may appoint.
body.text: This Act may be cited as the Buddhist Temporalities (Amendment) Act, No. 18 of 1981, and shall come into operation on such date (hereinafter referred to as the " appointed date ") as the Minister by Order published in the Gazette may appoint.

body.heading: Amendment of section 12 of Chapter 318.
body.raw_text: 2. Section 12 of the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance (hereinafter referred to as the "principal enactment") is hereby amended by the substitution for the proviso to that section of the following new proviso:
body.text: Section 12 of the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance (hereinafter referred to as the "principal enactment") is hereby amended by the substitution for the proviso to that section of the following new proviso:

children.raw_text: Provided that (a) the period of office of a Diyawadana Nilame shall be ten years; and
children.text: Provided that (a) the period of office of a Diyawadana Nilame shall be ten years; and

children.raw_text: (b) the period of office of a Basnayake Nilame may be extended by the President, if he is of opinion that it will be conducive to the efficient management of the property of a temple, for a period of one year at a time, so however, that the aggregate of such periods shall not exceed two years. body.heading: Application of amendment to section 12 to Basnayake Nilame holding office.
body.raw_text: 3.
